faq.q1: Do I need an appointment for the written test?
faq.a1: No — walk-ins are always welcome for the written knowledge test, no appointment needed. We'll screen a short prep video before you take the computerized exam.
faq.a2: Yes! Our entire team is bilingual, and this website works in both English and Spanish — just use the language switcher in the top menu.
faq.q3: What should I bring to my appointment?
faq.a3: A valid photo ID for all services, and your learner's permit if you're taking the practical driving exam. If you have questions about your specific situation, just reach out before your visit.
faq.q4: Can multiple people book the theoretical exam together?
faq.a4: Yes — this session can accommodate multiple students at once, so it's great if you're coming in with a friend or family member.
faq.q5: Do you offer driving lessons at my location?
faq.a5: We can come to you for driving lessons — a travel fee may apply depending on distance. Just let us know your preference when you submit a request.
faq.q6: Is submitting the booking form a guaranteed appointment?
faq.a6: Not automatically — think of it as a request. We'll confirm your appointment by phone, text, or email, and reach out with alternative times if your preferred slot isn't available.
faq.a7: Monday–Friday 8:00 AM–3:00 PM, Saturday 8:00 AM–1:00 PM, and we're closed Sundays.
